optimizer_policy: Fresh Adam in all four arms; shared original weights/codes, no Adam moment transfer across expanded shapes
width_initialization: Duplicate channels with fixed 16-channel normalization groups; preserve scale/shift ordering; zero-sum input-column perturbations break duplicate symmetry while preserving the initial function
code_initialization: Original 16 coordinates plus 48 zeros; extra projection columns initialized N(0,0.02), making extra code gradients nonzero
loss: original full RGB MAE + hand ROI MAE + (10/9)*motion MAE + 0.1*(balanced occupancy BCE + standardized feature MAE)
acceptance: Compare motion/object retention and trajectory on all trained windows and h9, plus fixed visual review; numerical improvement alone does not accept a teacher
scope: Single TRAIN clip; free-code/decoder capacity diagnostic. Not Q extraction, unseen-source generalization, quantization or AR. Compare these four matched fresh-Adam arms internally.
failure_policy: Stop failed branch, preserve checkpoint and failure record; no automatic scientific extension or GPU/process stealing
